initial_entry.description: A Firthian collocation explorer grounded in corpus linguistics. Extracts habitual lexical patterns from your vault using sliding-window co-occurrence, PMI, and log-likelihood, then surfaces them as an interactive word sphere with KWIC concordance views. - This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
